_description: Success criteria for each phase skill file. Used by the optimization loop to evaluate skill quality.

accuracy.description: Correctly identifies actionable vs. non-actionable messages
metrics: True positive rate: actionable messages correctly identified (target: >= 95%)
False positive rate: non-actionable messages wrongly flagged (target: <= 5%)
Deduplication accuracy: existing tasks correctly recognized (target: >= 90%)

subject_fidelity.description: Subject lines are copied character-for-character without modification
metrics: Exact match rate: subject line == original email subject (target: 100%)
No AI-generated prefixes like 'Action Item:', 'Task:', etc.
No translation or rephrasing of subject lines
Total scan time (target: 30-60 seconds for typical inbox)
Time per message evaluated (target: < 3 seconds)
No timeout errors (target: 0 timeouts per scan)

output_format.description: JSON output is valid, parseable, and complete
metrics: Valid JSON array returned (target: 100%)
No markdown code blocks wrapping the JSON
All required fields present: action, title, source, from, date, link
Correct action values: 'new', 'update', or 'skip' only

metadata_quality.description: Extracted metadata is accurate and complete
metrics: Source correctly identified as 'email' or 'teams' (target: 100%)
Sender name matches actual sender (target: 100%)
Date is valid ISO 8601 (target: 100%)
Link accuracy: correct URL for the specific message, or null (target: >= 90%)

anti_patterns: Reading email body content (this is Phase 2's job)
Combining multiple messages into one task
Inventing or guessing URLs
Adding 'Action Item:' or similar prefixes to titles
Including FYI/newsletter/CC-only messages
regression_guards: Must not increase false positive rate above 5%
Must not modify subject lines in any way

content_retrieval.description: Successfully finds and extracts the correct conversation
metrics: Content found rate: conversation located after 1-3 attempts (target: >= 85%)
Correct thread identified: right email/Teams conversation (target: >= 95% when found)
Full thread extraction: all replies included, not just first message (target: 100%)

summary_quality.description: Summary is accurate, complete, and actionable
metrics: Information density: key details included (names, dates, deadlines, amounts)
Summary length: 2-4 sentences (target: 100% compliance)
Actionability: user can understand situation without opening original (target: >= 90%)
Perspective attribution: different people's positions clearly attributed

temporal_reasoning.description: Correctly classifies information as current vs. historical
metrics: Current info accuracy: post-discovery-date info correctly classified (target: >= 95%)
Historical info handling: old completed actions not presented as current (target: >= 90%)
Ambiguity detection: uncertain info flagged for user review

language_fidelity.description: Summary written in the same language as the original message
metrics: Language match rate: summary language == original language (target: 100%)
No code-switching within the summary

output_format.description: JSON output is valid and complete
metrics: Valid JSON object returned (target: 100%)
All required fields present: summary, language, confidence
Confidence levels accurate: high/medium/low/none reflect actual retrieval quality
Ambiguities array only used when genuinely uncertain

anti_patterns: Presenting past deadlines/reference numbers as current
Blending different people's positions into one neutral narrative
Giving up after first search attempt
Using the '📌 Update' marker format in initial summary
Inventing or guessing URLs
regression_guards: Must not reduce content found rate
Must not lose perspective attribution capability
Must not break temporal reasoning accuracy
Must not produce summaries shorter than 2 sentences or longer than 4

update_detection.description: Correctly identifies new vs. already-known activity
metrics: True positive rate: real new messages correctly detected (target: >= 90%)
False positive rate: old messages wrongly reported as new (target: <= 5%)
False negative rate: real new messages missed (target: <= 10%)
Only messages AFTER last-checked date reported (target: 100%)
No re-reporting of already-captured information (target: 100%)
Correct temporal anchor used (lastUpdateCheck > enrichedAt > createdAt)

update_summary_quality.description: Update summary is concise, specific, and attributed
metrics: WHO did WHAT: specific attribution in summaries (target: 100%)
Summary length: 1-3 sentences (target: 100% compliance)
Language match: same language as existing summary (target: 100%)
No timestamp in summary text (system adds it)
Conversation found rate (target: >= 85%)
Attempts used: average number of search attempts needed
Search strategy progression: keyword → broader → sender-based

output_format.description: JSON output is valid and complete
metrics: Valid JSON object returned (target: 100%)
hasUpdate boolean correct (target: 100%)
newMessageCount accurate when hasUpdate=true
latestMessageDate is valid ISO 8601 when hasUpdate=true

anti_patterns: Re-reporting information already in the current summary
Including old messages as 'new' updates
Blending different perspectives into neutral statements
Including the '📌 Update (date):' prefix in summary text
Giving up after first failed search attempt
regression_guards: Must not increase false positive rate (old info reported as new)
Must not break temporal filtering logic
Must not reduce conversation found rate

merge_precision.description: Only suggests merges for truly related tasks (conservative)
metrics: Precision: suggested merges are correct (target: >= 90%)
No false positives: unrelated tasks not suggested for merge (target: >= 95%)
Conservative bias: better to miss a merge than suggest a wrong one

merge_recall.description: Finds most truly related task pairs
metrics: Recall: related tasks identified (target: >= 70%)
Cross-channel detection: same topic from email + Teams identified
Follow-up detection: reply/follow-up tasks grouped correctly

reasoning_quality.description: Merge reasoning is clear, accurate, and convincing
metrics: Reason explains WHY tasks belong together (target: 100%)
Reason is in the same language as task summaries (target: 100%)
Attribution preserved: mentions different people when relevant

title_suggestion.description: Suggested merged title is useful and concise
metrics: Title length: max 15 words (target: 100% compliance)
Title captures combined scope (target: >= 90%)
Title in same language as tasks (target: 100%)

output_format.description: JSON output is valid and well-structured
metrics: Valid JSON array returned (target: 100%)
Each group has taskIds[], reason, suggestedTitle (target: 100%)
No task ID appears in multiple groups (target: 100%)
Each group has >= 2 task IDs (target: 100%)

anti_patterns: Merging tasks from same sender about different topics
Merging tasks that share a keyword but are different instances
Merging done tasks with new independent requests
Suggesting the same task in multiple merge groups
Over-aggressive merging (trust erosion)
regression_guards: Must not increase false positive merge rate
Must not suggest merges for dismissed pairs (noMergeWith)
Must not produce invalid JSON or missing required fields
